title: Read a list (Hacker News top 3)
prompt: Use the browser. Go to https://news.ycombinator.com and tell me the titles and points of the top 3 stories. Answer briefly.

title: Fill and submit a form (httpbin)
prompt: Use the browser. Open https://httpbin.org/forms/post and fill it in: customer name "Ada Lovelace", telephone "5551234", e-mail "ada@example.com", pizza size Medium, toppings Bacon and Extra Cheese, preferred delivery time 19:30, delivery instructions "Ring twice". title: Find facts on a page (GitHub repo)
